caption:
Own a condo and want to move to an HDB resale flat? The 15 month wait is gone. 🏙️

Since 28 July 2026, private property owners can buy a non-subsidised HDB resale flat straight away, as long as:
1. You don't take an HDB loan (bank loan, cash or CPF is fine).
2. You get your HDB Flat Eligibility letter first.
3. You sell all your private homes, in Singapore and overseas, within six months of buying the flat.

Using a grant or an HDB loan? The 30 month wait still applies.

Comment your flat type and town, and we'll tell you which path fits you 👇

General information only. Check your eligibility with HDB.
